<div style="font-size:150%; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:4px;">Welcome to {{SITENAME}}</div>
This wiki collects knowledge and help around '''[[Special:MyLanguage/OmegaSim|OmegaSim]]''', a free app for controlling '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Carrera HYBRID|Carrera HYBRID]]''' cars via Bluetooth: with its own [[Special:MyLanguage/Fahrverhalten|driving feel]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Rennarten|races]], [[Special:MyLanguage/NPC-Fahrverhalten|NPC opponents]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Safety Car und Reinigungswagen|safety car]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Boxenstopp|pit stops]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Mehrspieler|multiplayer]]. There are currently '''{{NUMBEROFARTICLES}}''' articles here. The wiki is written in German; translations are being added step by step.

<span id="Erste_Schritte"></span>
== Getting started ==

# Open [[Special:MyLanguage/OmegaSim|OmegaSim]] in the browser or install the Android app.
# Switch on the car and pair it in the '''Garage''' with '''+ Connect a car'''.
# Under '''Options → Driving feel''' choose a preset; '''Arcade''' is best to start with.
# Drive off in the '''Cockpit''' or start a [[Special:MyLanguage/Rennarten|race type]] under '''Race'''.
# If the car hangs: [[Special:MyLanguage/Keine Reaktion des Fahrzeugs|Car does not respond]].

[[Datei:OmegaSim-Garage.png|mini|ohne|360px|The garage, where cars are connected.]]
